create_refer_dataset: create a REFER instance to load refcoco or refcocog dataset with specified splitBy
build_refer_index: build the REFER index mapping refs, anns, images, categories, and sentences
test_getRefIds: test the getRefIds method to retrieve reference ids filtered by image, category, or split
refactor_loadRefs: refactor the loadRefs method to load reference objects by specified ref ids
review_getMask: review the getMask method to compute mask and area of a referred object given a ref
